title: Spiced Halibut Gratin
description: A flavorful and moist halibut dish, baked in a creamy gratin with a hint of spice.

ingredients.name: Nordic crème fraîche
ingredients.notes: Can be substituted with regular crème fraîche

ingredients.name: Grated Gruyère cheese
ingredients.notes: Can be substituted with other hard cheeses

instructions: Season halibut fillets with salt and black pepper.
In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Sauté minced garlic until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add halibut fillets to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Transfer halibut to a baking dish and set aside.
In a separate bowl, mix Nordic crème fraîche and grated Gruyère cheese.
Sprinkle Norwegian spiced breadcrumbs on top of the halibut fillets.
Pour the crème fraîche mixture over the halibut, making sure they are fully coated.
Dot the top with remaining butter.
Bake in preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until the gratin is golden brown and bubbly.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
